title: hippion verticillatum var. maritimum
intro: Hippion verticillatum var. maritimum, commonly known as Sea Holly, is a variety of the Sea Holly plant that grows in coastal areas. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its ability to support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Sea Holly include its use as an expectorant to relieve coughs and congestion, as well as its role in reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Sea Holly include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
